neighbours.label: the slot right before the numeral 'one' (have [one], with [just one], each have [one]); output promotes ' one'
fire: Carriers stay healthy as long as they have at least one working copy of the gene.
Six of the counties each have one hospital, and the rest have none.
The pirate was a man with only one eye and a wooden leg.
Most people are born with two kidneys but can live with just one.
The small towns along the coast each have one school.
He met a sailor with one arm who told stories all night.
You only need one ticket to enter all three museums.
A cat with one ear wandered into our garden yesterday.
quiet: Carriers stay healthy as long as they eat well and sleep enough.
Six of the counties have large hospitals, and the rest have clinics.
The pirate was a man with a red beard and a loud voice.
Most people are born with healthy kidneys and never think about them.
The small towns along the coast have busy harbours.
He met a sailor with a parrot who told stories all night.
You only need a passport to enter all three museums.
A cat with orange fur wandered into our garden yesterday.
